latestVersion.changelog: Make task storage portable with monotonic stable IDs, literal matching, locked atomic writes, recoverable backups, and opt-in count-only heartbeats.

raw_record.summary: Persistent TODO scratch pad for tracking tasks across sessions. Use when the user asks to add, list, complete, remove, or summarize tasks in a portable workspace Markdown file. Uses stable task IDs and exact matching; heartbeat reporting is opt-in and count-only.
